qualitative.decay_resistance: moderately durable to very durable; old-growth tends to be more durable than younger second-growth
qualitative.workability: typically easy to work with hand or machine tools; figured stock may tear out
qualitative.grain_behavior: generally straight; figured pieces may be wavy or irregular
qualitative.dimensional_stability: source notes exceptional stability and very little shrinkage or seasonal movement

availability.legal_sourcing_notes: Not listed in CITES appendices; IUCN Red List status noted by source.
availability.market_notes: Mid to upper price range as construction lumber; clear or figured woodworking lumber more expensive.

unknowns: fastener behavior requires additional source or test data
ancient-grade availability requires separate legal/sourcing audit
